694bc9f3f575b5d358573733745676a329e60736.summary: Trend Micro's TrendLabs blog (published 2013-09-04) reports that the Sykipot backdoor, in use since 2007, was seen gathering information on the US civil aviation sector, a shift from its usual US defence industrial base targets. The report says the campaign expanded into civilian sectors and infrastructure, moved from file-based exploits toward DLL or process injection, and mainly arrives by email. Detection is named BKDR_SYKIPOT.AG. The report describes the intentions behind the new targeting as unclear.
